Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in Step 1 by incorrectly identifying the mother of Princess Margaretha of Saxony. The search results from the WebSurfer in Step 1 clearly stated that Margaretha was the daughter of "King John of Saxony and his wife Princess Amalie Auguste of Bavaria." However, the Planner ignored this explicit information and hallucinated that the mother was "Archduchess Luise of Austria-Tuscany." This error propagated through the entire conversation, leading the team to search for the birthplace of the wrong person (Luise) instead of the correct person (Princess Amalie Auguste of Bavaria).
